project.name: Transaction Categorizer
project.description: A React-based application that helps users upload bank statements, categorize transactions, and view results organized by category hierarchy.

epics.name: Excel File Upload
epics.description: Allow users to upload bank statement Excel files and process them

epics.name: Manual Transaction Entry
epics.description: Enable users to manually add transactions with description and amount

epics.name: View Grouped Transactions
epics.description: Display transactions organized by category and subcategory hierarchy

epics.name: Transaction Management
epics.description: View all transactions in table format with category details
